prBodyNotes: Upgrades through the system-upgrade-controller on merge, server first. Minor bump: take the SQLite copy first (CLAUDE.md, Upgrading k3s).

packageRules.description: Let a release settle for two weeks (3.6.0 changed how three apps are diffed); the image tag comes from GitHub releases because quay.io has no release dates
prBodyNotes: Not deployed by Argo. After merging: `helm repo update argo`, then the argocd playbook (`--start-at-task "Add ArgoCD Helm repo"`). The chart and image versions must match: check the chart's appVersion.
Not deployed by Argo: run the ollama playbook for ollama-01. The workstation gets Ollama from pacman.
Rendered chart: don't merge as is. Re-render both ARC charts with the commands in `kubernetes/helm/arc-runners-values.yaml`, apply the new CRDs, and push to this branch.
Upstream release manifests: replace `crd.yml` and `controller.yml` from the release (keep the kubectl image line), not just the tag.
